author: Doppelganger_
body:
Please be sure to include all the details of in the release thread. This makes anyone looking to give constructive criticism and people doing the Yaml life a whole lot easier. As a general format please have:
  • Map Name
  • Credit to the server owner. If it was built on a public server (ex. alexanderjoe1)
  • An overview picture of the map.
  • A short summary of what the map is (theme, aesthetics, what you were envisioning when you started the project etc.)
  • Pictures (preferably in an Imgur album), Download (preferably Dropbox or Mediafire) and YML(Github gists(need an account) or Pastebin(no account needed) work)
Information:
  • Authors and Contributors
  • Team Sizes
  • Spawn kit (picture or words)
  • How many monuments (DTM), Time Limit (TDM) 
  • Any quirks such as kill reward, potion effects or villagers and basically anything else we need to know about the map
Finally if you're feeling generous. Feel free to link this thread so more people can find this format.
P.S: I was inclined to make this thread more new and map makers as funky's "Proper Map Releases" thread does not go in-depth about what is needed for a discussion. This is not by any means a strict format. Feel free to use whatever format you want. Just be sure to include the same information as the format I have provided.
